title: Oven Toasted Nutty Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot Egyptian dish featuring lentils, unwaxed lemon, and lardons, perfect for a cold evening, this stew is egg-free-friendly and can be served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Korean brass bowl, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced lardons and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the bowl and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, unwaxed lemon juice, and crispy lardons to the bowl, stirring to combine.
Transfer the bowl to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
